"""Meridian CRM permission-check migration."""


def can(
    user: dict,
    action: str,
    object: str,
    record: dict,
    role_rows: list[dict],
) -> bool:
    """Return whether the user may perform the action on the record."""
    role_id = user.get("ROLE_ID", "")
    matching_rows = (
        row
        for row in role_rows
        if row.get("role_id", "") == role_id
        and row.get("object", "") == object
        and row.get("action", "") == action
    )

    if role_id == "ADMIN":
        scope_grants = any(True for _ in matching_rows)
    else:
        user_id = user.get("USR_ID", "")
        user_team = user.get("TEAM_CD", "")
        owner_id = record.get("OWNER_UID", "")
        owner_team = record.get("TEAM_CD", "")

        scope_grants = any(
            row.get("scope", "") == "ALL"
            or (
                row.get("scope", "") == "TEAM"
                and user_team == owner_team
            )
            or (
                row.get("scope", "") == "OWN"
                and owner_id == user_id
            )
            for row in matching_rows
        )

    if not scope_grants:
        return False

    if action == "DELETE":
        return record.get("DEL_FLG", "") in ("", "N")

    return True
